title: replay.export_started
description: M10B: emitted by cf-replay-export at the start of an export job, before the first frame is encoded. Per VAL-M10B-036 the audit ordering is exactly one replay_export_started -> N chapter_marker_emitted (chapter-time ascending) -> one replay_export_completed. Non-cosmetic.

bundle_path.description: Filesystem path to the run bundle directory that the export pipeline is reading.

output_path.description: Filesystem path of the output MP4 / MKV that will be written.

preset.description: Preset id selected for this export (one of the five DECLARED_PRESETS).

codec.description: Video codec resolved from the preset registry.

duration_seconds.description: Anticipated output duration in seconds. Optional at start; the completed event carries the authoritative final value.
